bagPolicy.summary: All bags over 12″x12″x6″ are prohibited and subject to search upon entry. Guests can refuse a bag search, but the venue may deny entry.
prohibited: Food or drinks (except items on allowed list)
bagPolicy.note: Oversized items can be checked at Coat Check.

parking.note: Limited parking spaces are available on a first-come, first-served basis in designated lots. Lot A opens 1 hour before doors, Lot C and Lot D open at 6:00 PM on weeknights and 4:30 PM on weekends. Valet parking is also available and opens one hour before doors.

rideshare.note: Drop off / pick up is located on Broad Street, next to the venue, immediately south of Poplar Street.

concessions.note: The venue prohibits outside food or drinks, except for water in a factory sealed or empty bottle. Concession stands are available on all accessible seating levels, offering a variety of food and drink options.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by The Met Presented by Highmark, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in The Met Presented by Highmark's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at The Met Presented by Highmark. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at The Met Presented by Highmark. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
